bullets.text: Companywide Q2 CR improved 3.6 pts YOY to 93.2; Personal Lines CR was 93.2; Commercial Lines CR 91.6; Property CR was 98.5, including ~6.5 pts of ARX acquisition-related amortization expense.
Q2 NPW grew 14% compared to Q2 2016 (13% year-over-year); Personal Lines NPW rose 14% (auto +15%, special lines +6%); Commercial Lines NPW was up 18%; Property new business applications grew 35%.
Progressive achieved 11 million auto PIF and 1 million boat PIF. Total auto PLE reached all-time highs, renewal rate gains were strong, and Robinsons PIF increased nearly 23% year-over-year.
Commercial Lines average written premium rose from late 2016 and early 2017 rate actions, with ~9 points of additional rate still to earn in on the portfolio.
Portfolio total return was 1.3% for Q2 (equities 3.5%, fixed income 1.1%); YTD return reached 3.1%; cash from operations was invested at reasonable yields while maintaining high quality.

Introduced 'Paths to Partnership' agent program with national auto commission schedule rewarding retention; Platinum agent ranks doubled YOY, driving Robinson agency growth; Progressive Advantage Agency continued expanding.

Policies ever enrolled in Snapshot crossed $4 billion in 12-month written premium. Snapshot mobile app expanded to 26 Direct states (38% enrollment versus 34% elsewhere); HomeQuote Explorer rolled out countrywide, excluding three states.
Claims photo estimating rolled out via mobile app, taking under 15 minutes; company finished its 50th state on auto processing system and entered first state on new commercial processing system.

Increased 2017 media spend further in Q2, supported by strong Direct auto profitability and favorable advertising results focused on homeowners insurance, auto/home bundling, and the new HomeQuote Explorer platform.

For Property, industrywide catastrophe losses continued well above average through six months; placed catastrophe reinsurance program, feeling the added aggregate stop-loss coverage provides more coverage than in the past.
